name: GET /api/events/types - List registered event types
description: Lists every event type in the compile-time EVENT_TYPE_REGISTRY together with its metadata and a count, for runtime discovery and validation by producers and consumers. Edge cases: the registry is static compile-time data with no DB access, so the response is identical on every call and never empty in a correctly built image; the route takes no parameters, no pagination and no tenant scoping - the registry is global, not per-tenant; the handler declares no requireAuth of its own, so its 401 comes from the gateway default-deny auth gate (the path is not on the public allowlist).

errorCases.when: Authorization header absent or not in the form "Bearer <jwt>" — enforced by the gateway default-deny auth gate, not by the route itself
JWT signature invalid, malformed, or past its exp claim — enforced by the gateway default-deny auth gate, not by the route itself
serializing the registry throws — logged and returned only if the reply has not already been sent
